As you step through the opening, you become swathed in a fine, gossamer mist. The Elizabethan tearoom fades hazily away, and vague, new shapes begin to form around you. Their outlines become more defined, their colours grow stronger, and the mist thins out into pale wisps, which gradually disperse away to nothingness...
